```artifact
Feature: Admin Management

  Scenario: Add Lab
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the lab "Lab 1" with address "123 Main St" does not exist
    When the admin adds the lab "Lab 1" with address "123 Main St"
    Then the lab "Lab 1" is added successfully

  Scenario: Add Chemist
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the chemist "Chemist 1" with email "chemist1@example.com" does not exist
    When the admin adds the chemist "Chemist 1" with email "chemist1@example.com"
    Then the chemist "Chemist 1" is added successfully

  Scenario: Update Doctor Information
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the doctor "Dr. Smith" with ID "1" exists
    When the admin updates the doctor "Dr. Smith" with ID "1" to have name "Dr. Johnson"
    Then the doctor "Dr. Johnson" with ID "1" is updated successfully

  Scenario: Maintain Specialities
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds a new speciality "Cardiology"
    Then the speciality "Cardiology" is added successfully

  Scenario: View and Update Speciality
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the speciality "Cardiology" exists
    When the admin views and updates the speciality "Cardiology"
    Then the speciality "Cardiology" is updated successfully

  Scenario: Delete Speciality
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the speciality "Cardiology" exists
    And no doctors are attached to the speciality "Cardiology"
    When the admin deletes the speciality "Cardiology"
    Then the speciality "Cardiology" is deleted successfully

  Scenario: Maintain Doctors
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds a doctor "Dr. Smith" with ID "1" to the speciality "Cardiology"
    Then the doctor "Dr. Smith" with ID "1" is associated with the speciality "Cardiology"

  Scenario Outline: Add Lab with Duplicate Name
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the lab "Lab 1" with address "123 Main St" exists
    When the admin adds the lab "Lab 1" with address "123 Main St"
    Then the lab addition fails with error code "LAB_NAME_DUPLICATE"

  Scenario Outline: Add Chemist with Invalid Data
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the chemist "Chemist 1" with email "chemist1@example.com" does not exist
    When the admin adds the chemist "Chemist 1" with email "invalid_email"
    Then the chemist addition fails with error code "CHEMIST_EMAIL_INVALID"

  Scenario Outline: Add Speciality with Invalid Name
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds a new speciality "Cardiology123"
    Then the speciality addition fails with error code "SPECIALITY_NAME_INVALID"

  Scenario Outline: Add Speciality with Name Length Exceeding Limit
    Given the admin is logged in
    When the admin adds a new speciality "Cardiology12345678901234567890"
    Then the speciality addition fails with error code "SPECIALITY_NAME_TOO_LONG"

  Scenario Outline: Add Doctor to Speciality with Invalid ID
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the speciality "Cardiology" exists
    When the admin adds a doctor "Dr. Smith" with ID "abc" to the speciality "Cardiology"
    Then the doctor association fails with error code "DOCTOR_ID_INVALID"

  Scenario Outline: Add Doctor to Speciality with Non-Existent ID
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the speciality "Cardiology" exists
    When the admin adds a doctor "Dr. Smith" with ID "2" to the speciality "Cardiology"
    Then the doctor association fails with error code "DOCTOR_ID_NOT_FOUND"

  Scenario Outline: Delete Speciality with Attached Doctors
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the speciality "Cardiology" exists
    And a doctor is attached to the speciality "Cardiology"
    When the admin deletes the speciality "Cardiology"
    Then the speciality deletion fails with error code "SPECIALITY_HAS_ATTACHED_DOCTORS"
```
